item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate\\nwith open('requests.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report == [evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]\\ncases=[({'declared':['z','a','z','ignored'],'saved':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'1','meta':{'n':1}},'a':{'kind':'directory','entries':['x']},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'undeclared':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'z':{'meta':{'n':1},'hash':'1','kind':'file'},'a':{'kind':'directory','entries':['y']},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'undeclared':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}}},{'ignored':['ignored']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),({'declared':['missing'],'saved':{},'current':{'missing':{'kind':'missing'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),({'declared':['p'],'saved':{'p':{'kind':'file','hash':'h','timestamp':1}},'current':{'p':{'kind':'file','hash':'h','timestamp':2}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['p']})]\\nfor req,pol,want in cases:\\n req0=copy.deepcopy(req); pol0=copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==want,(got,want); assert req==req0 and pol==pol0; assert set(got)=={'needs_review','changed'} and isinstance(got['needs_review'],bool) and got['changed']==sorted(got['changed'])\\nprint(json.dumps({'report':report,'boundary_results':[evaluate(r,p) for r,p,_ in cases]},sort_keys=True))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"status\",\"--short\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--check\"]}}]}"}
